Privacy Policy

What is collected

No analytics, no cookies, no tracking scripts. The site is static HTML and one stylesheet. Server logs at the host record IP and user agent for security and are not joined to anything.

Email

If you email, your address and message are kept for as long as the thread is useful.

Hosting

Pages are served by a third party static host. Their own logging policy applies to requests.

No affiliate tracking

Outbound Telegram links carry no tracking parameters.
